result.brief: 提出以可证伪假设表示环境动态的自演化世界模型，通过反例修正规则，提升 LLM 智能体在静态、漂移与科学发现任务上的表现。
result.reason: EvoBelief builds a symbolic, falsifiable world model of environment dynamics for LLM agents, not a video/multimodal foundation world model or visual representation; connection to stated directions is plausible but indirect.
